desc: The TWISTED RIVAL XP – NRL EDITION is the ideal choice for NRL Competition Shooters and hardcore hunters looking for the ultimate Long-Range Setup. This rifle features the deadly combination of Precision Machining, C3 Carbon technology and high level performance. We have loaded this rifle with high-end components and features. It includes our NEW RIVAL XP 2.0 C3 Carbon Stock with the new Push-Button Adjustable Cheek Piece and XP Detachable Mag Box. We have added the Trigger Tech Diamond Trigger , and hand lapped precision barrels. This rifle also comes with a Full-Length ARCA Rail and Compact ARCA Rail.
